notes: Premade character presets — scripts reference characters by NAME (e.g. 'Guide:') and the renderer binds the voice here. Keep names stable across the whole library so narration stays consistent. Spoken brand line is 'Focus Cast by focuslinks' — never 'focuslinks dot in' inside audio scripts (the .in suffix is written-only branding).
